What is Artificial Intelligence? (I bet you don't know, either.)

Released Nov 18, 2024, 15 min

Play What is Artificial Intelligence? (I bet you don't know, either.) on YouTube
Watch on YouTube

This is a channel about ontology, philosophy, and artificial intelligence. So, I should be able to define AI cleanly, right? Well, this is embarrassing...I don't have a good definition for AI. In this video, I offer four potential definitions that I don't like. I'll dive into those in more depth in the future. The bulk of the video is explaining why it matters that we don't have a clear definition. To summarize:

1. Clarity Matters

2. "AI" is ubiquitous.

3. "AI" is used to drive governmental policies.

4. We should be wary of self-interested gatekeepers.

5. Unreflective use of AI may lead to the next AI Winter.

Join me on the upcoming videos as I embark on a quest to define AI. Or at least learn something trying to do so. It'll be fun!
